originality.rationale: Seven specific primary or published comparable sources were checked. The already-published unimodular lemma is excluded from the novelty claim. A literature-supported distinction remains between noncyclic prime-affine-plane, cyclic prime-square, order-2p, principal-minor, and generic maximal-defect results versus the complete rank-resolved odd-squarefree order-3p enumeration. No inspected source directly states or implies the exact count without new specialization and incidence analysis. Residual implicit-coverage and bibliographic risks are acknowledged.
residual_risks: A stronger published theorem on maximal rank-deficient Fourier matrices might encode the complete 3p count implicitly; inspected portions of Delvaux--Van Barel did not display it.
Specialized older tables of cyclic 15 or 21 three-by-three minors may exist but were not located by actual title/formula/alias queries.
No independent bibliographic originality certification has been performed.

value.rationale: The smallest odd-squarefree cyclic family has qualitatively new rank-one Fourier-minor obstructions absent for 2p. This complete if-and-only-if incidence census resolves a natural interpolation/erasure invariant and includes nontrivial polynomial multiplicities, not an arbitrary finite table. Known rigidity machinery is used transparently; its combination with mixed-prime annihilator geometry is a motivated mathematical classification.
